title: prismatomeris glabra
intro: Prismatomeris glabra, commonly known as White Flower, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is a type of shrub native to tropical regions of Asia. Prismatomeris glabra has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health.
